notes: Product-scoped candidate for HTX's flexible/fixed Simple Earn deposit products rather than the entire HTX Earn suite, which also includes other product families. The Simple Earn Agreement is dated 25 January 2021 and was updated in March 2025, but that publication date is not automatically treated as the original product launch date. Canonical review should keep launch_date null unless a first-party launch event is found and should not convert promotional principal-return mechanics into a universal legal or solvency guarantee.

notes: Product-scoped candidate for the flexible savings/Financial Account line rather than all CoinEx Earn products. A 30 July 2025 first-party notice still calls the product Financial Account; the Flexible Savings help page was published 31 July 2025 and an August 2025 product-upgrade notice uses Flexible Savings. Reviewed sources establish continuity of core mechanics: yields are linked to Margin Trading/Loans borrowing rates, with CoinEx subsidies in the current product; redemptions can be delayed when idle savings assets are insufficient until borrowers return coins. The exact formal rename date and original Financial Account launch date remain unresolved, so canonical launch_date should not be invented without stronger evidence. Promotional low-risk/principal-protected wording must remain company characterization rather than a universal custody or solvency conclusion.
